_note: Job B batch 5. Four rows here are the cue firing on Ezekiel 37 being read aloud, where 'so I prophesied as I was commanded' is scripture rather than a claim of his own.

links.points_back_to: a vision recounting that shifts mid-passage from asteroids to restoration of the bride, with nothing said to have happened
the referent is not recoverable from the passage: he says it is just like the Lord said without naming what it is
the word about American oil production and reducing reliance on foreign oil
links.real_event: An Energy Department order addressing supply disruption risk and foreign oil reliance.

links.points_back_to: what he saw the previous night, given as a call to get ready for a coming revival
a discourse marker restating his own standing exhortation about one last call, not a claim that anything landed
the repeated word that drones bought from Amazon would carry explosive devices into stadiums
links.real_event: A drone incident he plays and calls exactly what he saw.

links.points_back_to: the word that Israel would strike the oil wells and cause havoc at the strait
the same strike word, with shipping halted
links.real_event: Tankers blown up and mines laid, which he offers before turning to the gas-line word that has not landed.

links.points_back_to: a vision recounting of technology that manipulates time and space, with a joke about giving away classified information
conditional and forward: this is what I told you when this all happens, describing what the Antichrist will do
the word about a short-lived window of stability given for a great harvest
links.real_event: Israeli removal of key leaders, offered as the stability that opens the window.

links.points_back_to: a vision recounting of Cuban cigars with a gold band, which he says he does not understand
the vision of a big crack in the wall
links.real_event: A photograph on screen that he identifies as what he saw.

links.points_back_to: a bare sign-off on the previous description, carrying no claim of its own
Ezekiel 37 read aloud: the prophesying is the prophet's in the text, not a claim of his
he is matching an animation of the dry bones passage to what he says he was shown, not matching a word to an event
Ezekiel 37 read aloud again in the same passage
a cross-reference between two of his own visions, with no event attached
the vision of a group of them flying together, which he says he had never seen before
links.real_event: Footage of a group flying in formation, which he calls practice.

links.points_back_to: Ezekiel 37 read aloud, including the interpretation given inside the text
the word about China moving on Taiwan while attention is elsewhere
links.real_event: Simultaneous pressure on Venezuela and Chinese resources, which he reads as the setup he saw.

links.points_back_to: forward-looking: he will beat the war drums, restating a warning rather than reporting it landed
a prayer request over a named royal family with no corresponding claim in the set and no event asserted
